from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, sys

campaign=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
model_task="A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4"
unit="prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4.service"
mr=campaign/"model_results"/f"{model_task}.json"

def run(*args):
    p=subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.strip(),p.stderr.strip()

if mr.exists():
    print("E119=R4_RESULT_EXISTS",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0)

rc,active,err=run("systemctl","--user","is-active",unit)
_,props,_=run("systemctl","--user","show",unit,"--property=ActiveState,SubState,Result,ExecMainStatus,ExecMainCode")
_,journal,_=run("journalctl","--user","-u",unit,"-n","20","--no-pager","-o","cat")
jlines=[x for x in journal.splitlines() if x.strip()]
tail=" | ".join(jlines[-4:])[-1200:]
print("E119_STATUS active="+repr(active)+" props="+repr(props.replace("\n",";"))+" tail="+repr(tail),flush=True)

p=props.lower()
a=active.strip().lower()
if a in {"active","activating","reloading"}:
    print("E119=WORKER_ACTIVE_RESULT_PENDING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(20)
if "result=success" in p and ("activestate=inactive" in p or a=="inactive"):
    print("E119=WORKER_EXITED_SUCCESS_NO_RESULT",flush=True); raise SystemExit(21)
if "activestate=failed" in p or a=="failed" or ("result=" in p and "result=success" not in p and "result=" + "" not in p):
    print("E119=WORKER_FAILED_NO_RESULT",flush=True); raise SystemExit(22)
if a=="inactive":
    print("E119=WORKER_INACTIVE_NO_RESULT",flush=True); raise SystemExit(23)
print("E119=WORKER_STATE_UNKNOWN_NO_RESULT",flush=True); raise SystemExit(24)
